description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingModifyCommand' within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify'. The interface aggregates commands that modify the state of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework and extends other interfaces for command behavior and optional entity handling.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommand
classes.description: A Java interface that represents commands which modify a Thing's state, extending core command interfaces and providing a method to check if the command changes authorization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command and returns the modified command instance.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Determines if executing this command would change the authorization of the Thing.
